name: The Snoopy Show
description: The world's most iconic dog is ready for his close-up. Dive into new adventures with the happy-dancing, high-flying, big-dreaming beagle, who's joined by best friend Woodstock and the rest of the Peanuts gang.

videos.title: Happiness Is a Dancing Dog
videos.overview: Snoopy writes a book about his younger days, reveals the origin of his friendship with Woodstock, and gets the dancing bug.

videos.title: Never Bug a Beagle
videos.overview: Snoopy invites Woodstock to move in with him, embarks on a mission to bring Sally's sandwich to school, and tries to cool off on a hot day.

videos.title: The Curse of a Fuzzy Face
videos.overview: Snoopy goes to a scary movie with Woodstock, advises Charlie Brown on his Halloween costume, and gives tricks to kids instead of treats.

videos.title: Happiness Is a Snow Day
videos.overview: Snoopy shows Marcie how to enjoy a snow day, helps Rerun retrieve a runaway sled, and builds a snowman with Woodstock.

videos.title: Just Your Basic Beagle
videos.overview: Snoopy forgets Woodstock's birthday, uses chores as payment at Lucy's yard sale, and replaces a daisy for Charlie Brown.

videos.title: Bugable, Hugable, Beagle
videos.overview: Woodstock protects a badminton birdie, Snoopy decides to pen a prize-winning novel, and he feels guilty when Rerun is injured while they’re playing.

videos.title: Better Off Beagle
videos.overview: Snoopy puts on a magic show that affects Woodstock, avoids going to the vet for his cold, and discovers the difficulties of making dinner.

videos.title: Beagle Days Ahead
videos.overview: Snoopy sets up a therapy booth to rival Lucy’s, co-parents a lost egg with Woodstock, and teaches Rerun how to ride a tricycle.

videos.title: Big Time Beagle
videos.overview: Snoopy comes to the rescue of his least favorite neighbor, gets stranded on a sandbar, and chauffeurs an injured Woodstock.

videos.title: Happiness Is a Good Book
videos.overview: Snoopy loses Sally’s balloon, creates chaos trying to win at mini golf, and has a hard time being quiet at the library.

videos.title: It Takes All Kinds to Make a World
videos.overview: Snoopy gets enrolled at Lucy’s etiquette school, drops the ball protecting a prop for the kids’ Earth Day play, and sets up a unique photo safari.

videos.title: Thank Goodness for Beagles
videos.overview: Snoopy invites his family over for dinner, leads the Beagle Scouts on a quest to find his brother Spike, and lets Olaf—another brother—sleep over.

videos.title: Speak Softly, and Carry a Beagle
videos.overview: Snoopy finds out Lucy’s definition of fun, coaches Charlie Brown in a potato sack race, and lets his imagination run wild thanks to Sally’s new bike.

videos.title: The Beagle Is In
videos.overview: Charlie Brown finds an extraordinary potato chip; Woodstock moves into a new nest; and Snoopy gets distracted cleaning his doghouse.

videos.title: Root Beer All Around
videos.overview: Snoopy gives Woodstock a makeover; loses Linus' beloved blanket; and heads to the skies for wild adventures.

videos.title: Well, I'll Be a Brown-Eyed Beagle
videos.overview: Snoopy takes a liking to a new stuffed bunny; plays cupid on Sally's behalf; and learns to keep his cool when he loses.

videos.title: Dogs Don't Say Goodbye
videos.overview: Lucy throws Rerun a birthday party; Snoopy stops at nothing to keep Woodstock from leaving; and Snoopy turns out to be a pogo stick pro.

videos.title: Beagle Appreciation Day
videos.overview: Schroeder wants to honor Beethoven properly; Woodstock stumbles upon a toy paradise; and Snoopy lets a day for beagles go to his head.

videos.title: Happiness Is a Rainy Day
videos.overview: Snoopy is asked to speak before the Head Beagle; tries to escape the modern world with his Beagle Scouts; and discovers rainy days can be fun.

videos.title: Déjà Beagle
videos.overview: Snoopy wants to have as much fun as he can before summer ends; Snoopy freshens up a game of fetch; and Lucy wakes up in a bad mood.

videos.title: All the World’s a Beagle
videos.overview: Charlie Brown plans a surprise party for Snoopy’s birthday; Snoopy proves he’s not lazy; and Snoopy takes Charlie Brown to court over a bad dinner

videos.title: Big Beagle on Campus
videos.overview: A newsletter gets the inside scoop on Charlie Brown; the gang learns to have fun from the cheap seats; and Spike invites Snoopy to the desert.

videos.title: Not Bad for a Beagle
videos.overview: Sally takes care of Snoopy for the weekend; Charlie Brown quits the baseball team; and Peppermint Patty uses Snoopy as a stand-in.

videos.title: Happiness Is Your Favorite Thing
videos.overview: Lucy hires Snoopy to protect her garden; Snoopy offers construction services to the neighborhood; and Snoopy’s old dog bowl is sorely missed.

videos.title: Happiness Is a Song in Your Heart
videos.overview: Charlie Brown wants more attention from Snoopy; Sally’s class pet makes Snoopy jealous; and Lucy believes musicals cause nothing but trouble.

videos.title: Happiness Is the Gift of Giving
videos.overview: Snoopy adapts a Christmas poem to help Sally sleep; Charlie Brown makes gifts for his pals; and Snoopy can't wait to open his presents.

videos.title: Happiness Is a Day at the Beach
videos.overview: Snoopy and Woodstock search for pirate treasure; the Flying Ace steals Sally's map; and Snoopy's expired dog license presents opportunities.

videos.title: Happiness Is a Hug That Lasts
videos.overview: Secret Agent Snoopy looks for Charlie Brown; the Beagle Scouts come to Woodstock's aid; and a hug from Snoopy goes into overtime.

videos.title: You're Up, Snoopy
videos.overview: Snoopy and Marcie help Peppermint Patty with her report; Rerun mistakes Snoopy for a leprechaun; and Marcie's quiet spot is discovered.

videos.title: This Is Your Life, Snoopy
videos.overview: Lucy gives Snoopy a test; Spike and Snoopy forget to agree where to meet up; and Snoopy turns the tables on rejection letters.

videos.title: Nobody's Perfect, Snoopy
videos.overview: Snoopy quits the baseball team; Peppermint Patty feels left out of Marcie and Snoopy's playdate; and Snoopy fears a falling moon.

videos.title: Who Put the Beagle in Charge?
videos.overview: Linus wants to thwart Snoopy's blanket-stealing ways; Charlie Brown finally hits a home run; and Woodstock sends Snoopy a bill for a wild party.

videos.title: Happiness Is a Good Skate
videos.overview: Snoopy needs ice to practice his quadruple axel; competes in the Alpine Beagle Games; and fills in for Marcie on the track.

videos.title: A Beagle's Tale
videos.overview: Franklin considers getting a dog; an injured Snoopy doesn't want Charlie Brown's help; and Peppermint Patty seeks writing advice.

videos.title: It's All You, Snoopy
videos.overview: Snoopy moves his doghouse to avoid the cat next door; referees neighborhood conflicts; and is interviewed by Peppermint Patty.

videos.title: Never Trust a Hungry Beagle
videos.overview: Sally asks Snoopy to keep her awake so she can see a comet; Charlie Brown tries recording team practice; and Snoopy's a poor sport at marbles.

videos.title: The Beagle Did It!
videos.overview: A puzzle frustrates Snoopy; Sally gets a lesson on summer-camp fun; and Snoopy's height falls short of the best carnival rides.

videos.title: Forever Snoopy
videos.overview: Snoopy starts an advice column; gets permission at last to go to school; and reminisces about his favorite things.

videos.title: Happiness Is Holiday Traditions
videos.overview: Snoopy searches for the perfect tree topper; Woodstock gets trapped in a window display; and Snoopy and Woodstock visit Spike for Christmas.
